subject: Pricing & launch incentives proposal for BlueWave pilot
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & launch incentives proposal for BlueWave pilot

Hi Lena,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation on how BlueWave wants to embed summarization and clinical note generation into your provider portal. Per our call you asked for a succinct breakdown of commit/discount options and what we can do to make a pilot/launch attractive from a commercial perspective. High level options below, happy to iterate: 

- Pilot (POC): $50k in platform credits, 6-week technical pilot, no upfront commit required. Credits apply to Hosted API usage and to observability add-ons; unused credits expire after 180 days unless converted to a committed contract.
- Commit Tier A: $50k annual commit => 20% off per-token list price for duration of the commit + $10k launch credits applied on signature.
- Commit Tier B: $200k annual commit => 30% off per-token list price + $50k launch credits + co-marketing/referral support.

Per-token list price (hosted API, standard models) is $0.0006/token — discounts apply to that baseline. We can add additional concessions (longer credit expiry, custom SLA) when the commit moves to Dedicated or Private.

If you want, we can put a formal grid together and send a DocuSign for the pilot / commit option you prefer. I can also loop in legal to get a DPA and SOC 2 evidence to you.

Next steps: which option looks closest to what BlueWave needs? If Pilot, I can send the $50k credit agreement and propose a kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & launch incentives proposal for BlueWave pilot

Hi Dev —

Appreciate the summary, this helps. A few clarifying questions before we move to an agreement: 

1) Can you send a concrete discount schedule (per-token price after discount) for the two commit tiers? We need line items to run through procurement.
2) For the pilot credits: does BlueWave need to prepay to receive the $50k credit or is that provided at signature?
3) Credit expiry: 180 days is short for a clinical launch — would your team consider 12 months if we choose the Commit Tier A?
4) Procurement will require Net 30 payment terms and a DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence. Is that doable?
5) Any restrictions on how credits are applied (e.g., only to compute usage vs. also covering embeddings/observability)?

If you can send a short written proposal we can route to legal/procurement. I’m copying procurement and will wait for the formal grid.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | BlueWave Health
procurement@bluewavehealth.com

Looping you in — Lena from BlueWave asked for a concrete discount schedule and confirmation on credits, expiry, and procurement terms. Drafting a formal grid and would like sales/legal guidance on the concession levels below before I send to the customer. Attachment: discount_grid.xlsx (draft).

Key asks from customer: concrete per-token numbers, confirmation of Net 30, DPA + SOC2, and potential extension of credit expiry to 12 months if we get a commit.

My suggested starting point (open to edits):
- Pilot: $50k credits, provided on signature of pilot agreement, credits applied to all Hosted API usage + embeddings + Redwood Console; expiry 180 days.
- Tier A (recommended): $50k annual commit -> list price $0.0006/token - 20% = $0.00048/token; $10k bonus credits on signature; Net 30.
- Tier B: $200k annual commit -> 30% off = $0.00042/token; $50k launch credits + co-marketing; Net 30.

Questions for legal: can we extend pilot credit expiry to 12 months on conversion? Any issues with credit application as above?

Thanks — please reply inline.

— Dev
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing & launch incentives proposal for BlueWave pilot

Dev — good framing. My recommended commercial structure:

1) Pilot (POC)
- $50k in platform credits, applied at signature of pilot agreement.
- Pilot length: 6 weeks.
- Credits apply to Hosted API usage (generation + embeddings) and Redwood Console feature flags/observability.
- If BlueWave signs a commit within 90 days of pilot completion, unused pilot credits roll into the committed account and expire 12 months after signature. If not converted, remaining credits expire after 180 days.

2) Commit Tier A (entry) — $50k annual commit
- Per-token: $0.0006 list -> 20% discount -> $0.00048/token.
- $10k launch credits on signature.
- Net 30 payment terms.
- 12 month price protection (no increase to per-token price during the commit term).

3) Commit Tier B (growth) — $200k annual commit
- Per-token: $0.0006 list -> 30% discount -> $0.00042/token.
- $50k launch credits + co-marketing support (joint case study).
- Priority access to new quantized variants and Dedicated capacity for launch windows.

Operational asks: DPA + SOC2 evidence will be provided during procurement; SSO/SCIM is achievable via our standard integrations.

Rishi — please confirm DPA language and whether we can do the 90-day conversion window on credits and 12-month expiry on conversion.

If legal signs off, Dev can send a one-page commercial summary + DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing & launch incentives proposal for BlueWave pilot

All — legal is generally okay with the proposed structure. A few changes we should include before sending externally: 

- Pilot credits: clarify that credits are non-refundable and will offset invoiced usage; include an explicit conversion window (90 days) in the pilot agreement. If converted to a commit, unused credits will be credited to the first invoice and any remaining credits will expire 12 months after commitment signature.
- DPA: required. We will provide our standard DPA and SOC2 Type II report link. Add a clause for data processing subprocessing list.
- Pricing protection: agree to 12 months price protection after signature of commit.
- DocuSign: I will prepare a DocuSign-ready commercial appendix and the DPA reference. Please attach discount_grid.xlsx to the DocuSign packet.

No redlines that block going to the customer; Dev, send the proposal with the two-tier grid and include the DocuSign link to the packet.

— Rishi

Dev —

Thank you — this is clear and we appreciate the flexibility. A few quick items before procurement signs: 

1) SLOs and monitoring: can you provide the Redwood Console page or a short SLI/SLO summary we can attach to our procurement packet? We need latency percentiles and uptime guarantees for our launch environment.
2) Confirmation that pilot credits do not require prepayment and will be applied on signature.
3) Small question on credit usage: want confirmation that embeddings are covered by the credits (you mentioned that but procurement asked for it explicitly).

Assuming the above are ok, procurement will review and we can route the DocuSign packet next week. Kicking off the pilot the week of 3/16 would work for our engineering team.

Best,
Lena
